rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for physically opening something that was folded.

example.english: I had to unfold the map for everyone to see.
example.traditional: 我唯有將張地圖攤開畀大家睇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 wai4 jau5 zoeng1 zoeng1 dei6 tou4 taan1 hoi1 bei2 daai6 gaa1 tai2

rows.note: Use this when something opens out or becomes unfolded, especially curtains, sheets, or shapes.

example.english: The bedsheet will unfold across the bed.
example.traditional: 張床單會喺床上展開晒。
example.jyutping: zoeng1 cong4 daan1 wui5 hai2 cong4 soeng6 zin2 hoi1 saai3

rows.note: Use this for events or a situation developing and turning out over time.

example.english: No one knows how the matter will unfold in the end.
example.traditional: 件事最後會點樣發展，冇人知。
example.jyutping: gin6 si6 zeoi3 hau6 wui5 dim2 joeng6 faat3 zin2 mou5 jan4 zi1

rows.note: Use this when information, intentions, or details are revealed rather than a physical object opening.

example.english: They gradually unfold the details of the plan to us.
example.traditional: 佢哋逐步透露個計劃嘅細節畀我哋知。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 zuk6 bou6 tau3 lou6 go3 gai3 waak6 ge3 sai3 zit3 bei2 ngo5 dei6 zi1
